_about: Our own words for each developer project, written for Manav Narula Realtor (agent, not developer). The importer fills these into empty fields only; anything edited in Admin > Projects is never overwritten. Facts (RERA, units, sizes, distances) come from the importer, not from here.

mexmon-dreams-jalandhar.description:
Mexmon Dreams is a gated apartment township by Mexmon Group on 66 Feet Road, in Urban Estate Phase II Extension, Jalandhar. Phase 1 spreads over about 10 acres, with eight towers holding around 1,183 two- and three-bedroom homes, planned by the architecture practice of Hafeez Contractor.

The towers rise between 18 and 24 floors above stilt parking. Around 80% of the land stays open, including roughly 1.3 acres of landscaped gardens with water features, a jogging track and gazebos, and a 40,000 sq ft clubhouse sits at the centre of the amenities.

We are not the developer. As sales agents in Jalandhar, we can take you through the floor plans, current availability and the price list, arrange a site visit, and help you compare home loan offers before you book.
highlights: 2 BHK homes suited to smaller families and 3 BHK homes with room for joint families
Planned by the architecture practice of Hafeez Contractor
Built with Mivan aluminium-formwork construction
Four balconies per home, with no flat looking straight into another
About 80% open and green area and a 40,000 sq ft clubhouse
Three-tier security, including AI-assisted monitoring

faqs.q: Which apartment types are available at Mexmon Dreams?
faqs.a: Two- and three-bedroom apartments. Carpet areas and prices vary by tower and floor, so ask us for the current floor plans and price list.
On 66 Feet Road in Urban Estate Phase II Extension, Jalandhar. By the developer's estimate it is about 5 minutes from Urban Estate Phase I and 10 minutes from Model Town market.
The towers are planned by the architecture practice of Hafeez Contractor, with Mivan construction for the structure.

2-bhk-flats-jalandhar.description:
The two-bedroom homes at Mexmon Dreams are planned for a couple or a small family who want a compact home without giving up light and air. Each one has four balconies, and the towers are arranged so that no flat looks straight into another.

Like the rest of the township they are built with Mivan aluminium formwork and sit inside the gated campus on 66 Feet Road. Unit sizes and the current price list come from the developer: ask us and we will share the latest figures, the layout and what is still available.
highlights: Planned for couples and small families
Four balconies in every home
No flat faces another directly
Mivan construction inside a gated campus

2-bhk-flats-jalandhar.seo_description: 2 BHK apartments at Mexmon Dreams, 66 Feet Road, Jalandhar, by Mexmon Group. Layout, availability and price on request. Site visits with Manav Narula Realtor.

3-bhk-flats-jalandhar.description:
The three-bedroom homes at Mexmon Dreams suit larger households, including joint families who want shared living space as well as rooms of their own. Layouts are planned for cross-ventilation, and the towers are placed so that no flat looks straight into another.

The homes share the township's Mivan construction, gated campus and clubhouse on 66 Feet Road. Sizes and prices are released by the developer, so ask us for the current 3 BHK layout, price list and availability before you visit.
highlights: Room for joint and larger families
Layouts planned for cross-ventilation
No flat faces another directly
Designed by the Hafeez Contractor practice

affordable-apartments-jalandhar.description:
Mexmon Dreams is positioned as a value project: the developer aims to keep both the 2 BHK and 3 BHK homes within reach of first-time buyers while keeping the features of a larger township. That means a gated campus on 66 Feet Road, security at the gate, and the same four-balcony layouts as the rest of the project.

If you are buying your first home, we can work out a budget with you, compare loan offers from our partner banks and tell you which units fit it before you book a visit.
highlights: 2 BHK and 3 BHK options for first-time buyers
Gated campus on 66 Feet Road
Four balconies in every home
Home loan comparison through our partner banks

boutique-apartments-jalandhar.description:
Mexmon Dreams describes its homes as boutique apartments: a smaller number of homes per floor, design work by the Hafeez Contractor practice and a long list of shared facilities for every age group, from the clubhouse and pool to the jogging track and gardens.

Both 2 BHK and 3 BHK homes are part of this offer. Ask us which towers and floors are open, and we will arrange a visit to the site and the clubhouse.
highlights: Design by the Hafeez Contractor practice
More than 40 shared amenities
Clubhouse, pool, gardens and jogging track
Available in 2 BHK and 3 BHK

mexmon-dreams-1-jalandhar.description:
Mexmon Dreams-1 is a plotted township by Mexmon Group on Sahibzada Ajit Singh Nagar Road, Jalandhar. It brings together 102 residential plots, meant for buyers who want to build their own villa, and 39 shop-cum-office (SCO) units for businesses and investors.

The layout includes landscaped parks, a dedicated children's play area, wide internal roads and parking for residents and visitors, with security around the clock.

As sales agents, we can share the plot sizes on offer, the current price list and the registration details, and walk the site with you before you decide.
highlights: 102 residential plots for building your own villa
39 SCO units within the same township
Landscaped parks and a children's play area
Wide internal roads with resident and visitor parking
24×7 security

faqs.q: What can I buy at Mexmon Dreams-1?
faqs.a: Residential plots for building a villa, and shop-cum-office (SCO) units for a business or as an investment.
On Sahibzada Ajit Singh Nagar Road, Jalandhar. We can take you to the site and show the surrounding schools, hospitals and markets.

mexmon-highstreet-jalandhar.description:
Mexmon Highstreet is a commercial project by Mexmon Group on 66 Feet Road, Jalandhar, with 33 shop-cum-office (SCO), showroom and office units over three floors.

Every two units share a lift, which makes it easier for customers to reach the upper floors and for you to move stock. The complex also has parking and a landscaped courtyard with lawns.

We can share unit sizes, frontages and the current price list, and arrange a visit so you can judge the location and passing traffic for yourself.
highlights: 33 commercial units over three floors
SCO, showroom and office formats
One shared lift for every two units
Landscaped courtyard and lawns
Frontage on 66 Feet Road

faqs.q: What kind of units does Mexmon Highstreet have?
faqs.a: Shop-cum-office (SCO) units, showrooms and offices, 33 units in all over three floors.

faqs.q: How do customers reach the upper floors?
faqs.a: Each pair of units shares a lift, so upper-floor shops and offices are easy to reach and goods are easy to move.

mexmon-palm-city-jalandhar.description:
Mexmon Palm City is a gated plotted community by Mexmon Group on 66 Feet Road, Jalandhar. It offers 50 residential plots for building a villa and 35 shop-cum-office (SCO) units for retail and offices, set among landscaped parks.

Residents get green lawns, walking paths, a children's play area and recreation spaces for all ages, with 24×7 security at the gate.

Talk to us for plot dimensions, the SCO layout, current prices and the registration details, and we will arrange a site visit at a time that suits you.
highlights: 50 residential plots for villas
35 SCO units for retail and offices
Landscaped parks, lawns and walking paths
Children's play area and recreation for all ages
24×7 security

agi-jalandhar-heights-ii.description:
Jalandhar Heights II is a phase of AGI Infra's Jalandhar Heights township. Homes run from two to four bedrooms, sized from about 1,330 to 2,400 sq ft, with larger 4+1 BHK homes in the Iconic Tower and a few penthouses.

Around 76% of the phase is open and green. Residents have a clubhouse with a restaurant, banquet hall, gym and pool, courts for squash, basketball and badminton, and banks and convenience stores inside the complex, with a multiplex and a mall within walking distance.

We are not the developer. As sales agents, we can show you the blocks and floor plans, check what is available, and arrange a visit.
highlights: Two- to four-bedroom homes, plus 4+1 BHK homes and penthouses
About 76% open and green area
Clubhouse with restaurant, banquet hall, gym and swimming pool
Banks, laundry and convenience stores within the complex
Multiplex and shopping mall within walking distance

faqs.q: Which apartment sizes are available at Jalandhar Heights II?
faqs.a: 2 BHK from about 1,330 sq ft, 3 BHK around 1,600 sq ft and 4 BHK from about 2,150 to 2,400 sq ft, plus 4+1 BHK homes and penthouses. Ask us which blocks have homes available.

agi-jalandhar-heights-iii.description:
Jalandhar Heights III is a phase of AGI Infra's Jalandhar Heights township at Pholriwal, with 3 BHK homes of about 1,720 sq ft, 4 BHK homes of about 2,800 sq ft, and duplexes of about 4,200 sq ft, with penthouses in the high-rise towers.

The towers use Mivan construction, and around 84% of the phase is open and green. Residents share a clubhouse with a restaurant, banquet hall, gym and pool, play areas, courts and on-campus medical help.

As sales agents, we can take you through each block, the duplex layouts and current availability, and book your site visit.
highlights: 3 BHK, 4 BHK and duplex homes, with penthouses
Mivan construction
About 84% open and green area
Clubhouse with restaurant, banquet hall, gym and swimming pool
Two-tier security

faqs.q: What sizes are available at Jalandhar Heights III?
faqs.a: 3 BHK of about 1,720 sq ft, 4 BHK of about 2,800 sq ft, and duplexes of about 4,200 sq ft. Penthouses are available in the 3 and 4 BHK towers.

agi-jalandhar-heights-iv.description:
The newest phase of AGI Infra's Jalandhar Heights township, Jalandhar Heights IV offers homes from three bedrooms up to 5+1 BHK, sized from about 1,800 to 3,600 sq ft.

Around 83% of the phase is open and green, and the structure is designed for Seismic Zone V. Amenities run to more than 30, including a rooftop pool, spa, banquet halls, courts, a jogging track and dedicated spaces for children and senior citizens, and every flat has a panic button.

We are not the developer. As sales agents, we can compare the four layouts with you, check availability by block and arrange a visit.
highlights: Four layouts, from 3 BHK to 5+1 BHK
About 83% open and green area
Structure designed for Seismic Zone V
A panic button in every flat
Rooftop swimming pool, spa and more than 30 amenities

faqs.q: What layouts are available at Jalandhar Heights IV?
faqs.a: 3 BHK of about 1,800 sq ft, 4 BHK of about 2,500 sq ft, 4+1 BHK of about 2,800 sq ft and 5+1 BHK of about 3,600 sq ft, each in specific blocks. We can share the floor plans.

Around 88% of the site is open and green. Residents share a clubhouse with a restaurant, banquet hall, gym and pool, play areas for children, courts for squash, basketball and badminton, and banks and stores within the complex.

As sales agents, we can show you the floor plan, check which floors are available and arrange a visit.

About 1,300 sq ft, carpet area about 960 sq ft
About 88% open and green area
Clubhouse with restaurant, banquet hall, gym and swimming pool

agi-sky-garden-jalandhar.description:
AGI Sky Garden is a group of residential projects by AGI Infra on G.T. Road, Jalandhar, made up of Sky Garden I, II and III and Maxima I and II. Homes are 2 BHK of about 820 to 880 sq ft and 3 BHK of about 1,200 to 1,300 sq ft.

Around 68% of the area is open and green. Amenities include a clubhouse with a lounge and restaurant, rooftop and indoor pools, a gym, courts, a jogging track, play areas, a dispensary and a shopping complex within the premises.

As sales agents, we can tell you which of the five projects has homes available, share the floor plans and arrange a visit.

About 68% open and green area
Clubhouse, rooftop and indoor swimming pools
Dispensary and doctor on campus
Shopping complex within the premises

faqs.q: Which projects make up AGI Sky Garden?
faqs.a: AGI Sky Garden I, II and III and AGI Maxima I and II, all on G.T. Road, Jalandhar.

agi-sky-villas-ludhiana.description:
On Pakhowal Road in Ludhiana, AGI Infra's Sky Villas is a luxury apartment project a short drive from Phullanwal Chowk and 200 Feet Road. Homes are 4 BHK of about 2,600 to 4,000 sq ft and 5 BHK of about 5,200 sq ft, with penthouses.

Ceilings are generous, at 3.6 metres floor to floor, and around 80% of the site is open and green. Amenities include a rooftop pool, spa, banquet halls, courts and a jogging track, with five-tier security and a panic button in every flat.

Although this project is in Ludhiana, we handle enquiries, site visits and home loan comparisons for it from our Jalandhar office.
highlights: Four- and five-bedroom homes, plus penthouses
3.6 m floor-to-floor height
About 80% open and green area
Five-tier security with a panic button in every flat
Close to 200 Feet Road and Phullanwal Chowk

faqs.q: What sizes are available at AGI Sky Villas?
faqs.a: 4 BHK of about 2,600, 3,500 or 4,000 sq ft, and 5 BHK of about 5,200 sq ft, plus penthouses.

faqs.q: Do you handle a Ludhiana project from Jalandhar?
faqs.a: Yes. We arrange site visits, share floor plans and compare home loans for AGI Sky Villas from our Jalandhar office.
